info.title: AspireLove.Cli
info.description: Make Lovable projects independent of Lovable/Supabase cloud by generating a local .NET Aspire AppHost.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: aspire.love — make Lovable projects independent of the Lovable/Supabase cloud.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Generate an Aspire AppHost into an existing Lovable project.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the root of the Lovable project. [default: <path>]

options.name: --name
options.description: Project name. Defaults to the package.json name, then 'MyAspireLove'.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Organization name shown in Supabase Studio. [default: My Company]

options.name: --mode
options.description: Supabase mode: FullLocal, SupabaseSync or RemoteConnect. [default: FullLocal]

options.name: --monitoring
options.description: Add the Grafana/Tempo/OpenTelemetry observability stack (local modes only). [default: False]

options.name: --persistent-storage
options.description: Persist Supabase Storage when deployed (Azure Files NFS + MinIO S3; local modes only). [default: False]

options.name: --deploy-script
options.description: Generate a guided scripts/deploy.ps1 for deploying to Azure with azd. [default: False]

options.name: --lovable-api-key
options.description: Lovable AI gateway key, so the project's built-in AI keeps working locally.

options.name: --db-password
options.description: Local Postgres password. [default: local-dev-password-123]

options.name: --user-name
options.description: Default admin user name. [default: admin]

options.name: --user-email
options.description: Default admin user email. [default: admin@localhost]

options.name: --user-password
options.description: Default admin user password. [default: admin]

options.name: --sync-project-ref
options.description: Supabase project ref to sync from (SupabaseSync mode).

options.name: --sync-service-key
options.description: Service key for sync (SupabaseSync mode).

options.name: --sync-db-password
options.description: Database password for sync (SupabaseSync mode).

options.name: --sync-management-token
options.description: Management token for sync (SupabaseSync mode).

options.name: --remote-project-ref
options.description: Supabase project ref to connect to (RemoteConnect mode).

options.name: --remote-service-key
options.description: Service key (RemoteConnect mode).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be generated without writing any files. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Proceed even if there are warnings. [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Check for and install the latest version of aspire.love.
